CREATE TRIGGER `imc_mr_managers_imc005_ai` AFTER INSERT ON `IMC005_Match_Reports` FOR EACH ROW UPDATE `IMC005_Results` r SET r.home_sm_manager_id=IF(LOWER(r.home_name) IN ('forfar athletic','metropolitan police'),NULL,IF(NEW.home_sm_manager_id>0,NEW.home_sm_manager_id,r.home_sm_manager_id)), r.away_sm_manager_id=IF(LOWER(r.away_name) IN ('forfar athletic','metropolitan police'),NULL,IF(NEW.away_sm_manager_id>0,NEW.away_sm_manager_id,r.away_sm_manager_id)) WHERE r.game_world_id=NEW.game_world_id AND r.sm_fixture_id=NEW.sm_fixture_id AND (NOT(r.home_sm_manager_id <=> IF(LOWER(r.home_name) IN ('forfar athletic','metropolitan police'),NULL,IF(NEW.home_sm_manager_id>0,NEW.home_sm_manager_id,r.home_sm_manager_id))) OR NOT(r.away_sm_manager_id <=> IF(LOWER(r.away_name) IN ('forfar athletic','metropolitan police'),NULL,IF(NEW.away_sm_manager_id>0,NEW.away_sm_manager_id,r.away_sm_manager_id))))
